sentences.en: A A port must be distinguished from a harbour.
sentences.zh: 港口必须有别于港口。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: They are two very different things.
sentences.zh: 它们是两个非常不同的事物。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Most ports have poor harbours, and many fine harbours see few ships.
sentences.zh: 大多数港口港口的港口条件差,许多好港口的船舶很少。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Harbour is a physical concept, a shelter for ships; port is an economic concept, a centre of land-sea exchange which requires good access to a hinterland even more than a sea-linked foreland.
sentences.zh: 港口是一个有形概念,是船舶的避港;港口是一个经济概念,是海上交换的中心,它要求人们能够进入内陆,甚至比与海洋相连的前野还要好。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It is landward access, which is productive of goods for export and which demands imports, that is critical.
sentences.zh: 关键是从土地获取,这是出口货物的生产,需要进口。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Poor harbours can be improved with breakwaters and dredging if there is a demand for a port.
sentences.zh: 如果对港口的需求大,那么,贫穷的港口可以通过防波堤和疏浚来改善。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Madras and Colombo are examples of harbours expensively improved by enlarging, dredging and building breakwaters.
sentences.zh: 马德拉斯和科伦坡是扩大、疏浚和建造防水堤,使港口得到昂贵改善的例子。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: B Port cities become industrial, financial and service centres and political capitals because of their water connections and the urban concentration which arises there and later draws to it railways, highways and air routes.
sentences.zh: B 港口城市成为工业、金融和服务中心和政治首都,因为它们的供水和城市集中,后来又从铁路、公路和航空路线上引来。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Water transport means cheap access, the chief basis of all port cities.
sentences.zh: 水运意味着廉价的交通,这是所有港口城市的主要基础。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Many of the world’s biggest cities, for example, London, New York, Shanghai, Istanbul, Buenos Aires, Tokyo, Jakarta, Calcutta, Philadelphia and San Francisco began as ports – that is, with land-sea exchange as their major function – but they have since grown disproportionately in other respects so that their port functions are no longer dominant.
sentences.zh: 世界上许多最大的城市,例如伦敦、纽约、上海、伊斯坦布尔、布宜诺斯艾利斯、东京、雅加达、加尔各答、费城和旧金山,最初都是港口 — — 即以陆海交换为主要功能 — — 但后来在其他方面增长过大,因此港口功能不再占支配地位。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: They remain different kinds of places from non-port cities and their port functions account for that difference.
sentences.zh: 它们仍然是与非港口城市不同的地点,其港口功能造成这种差异。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

words.def: 非会议非会议非会议非会议

sentences.en: C Port functions, more than anything else, make a city cosmopolitan.
sentences.zh: C港口比其他任何事物都更能发挥功能,使城市成为世界大都市。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: A port city is open to the world.
sentences.zh: 港口城市向世界开放。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In it races, cultures, and ideas, as well as goods from a variety of places, jostle, mix and enrich each other and the life of the city.
sentences.zh: 种族、文化和思想,以及来自不同地方的商品, 杂耍、混合和丰富彼此和城市生活。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The smell of the sea and the harbour, the sound of boat whistles or the moving tides are symbols of their multiple links with a wide world, samples of which are present in microcosm within their own urban areas.
sentences.zh: 海洋和港口的气味、船只哨声或潮汐的声响,是它们与广大世界多重联系的象征,其样本存在于它们自己的城市地区的微缩胶层中。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: D Sea ports have been transformed by the advent of powered vessels, whose size and draught have increased.
sentences.zh: 装有动力的船舶的出现改变了海港,其大小和潮水都有所增加。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Many formerly important ports have become economically and physically less accessible as a result.
sentences.zh: 许多以前重要的港口因此在经济和物质上都变得难以进入。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: By-passed by most of their former enriching flow of exchange, they have become cultural and economic backwaters or have acquired the character of museums of the past.
sentences.zh: 它们以前大部分丰富的外汇流动都绕过它们,成为文化和经济的后水,或具有过去博物馆的特点。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Examples of these are Charleston, Salem, Bristol, Plymouth, Surat, Galle, Melaka, Soochow, and a long list of earlier prominent port cities in Southeast Asia, Africa and Latin America.
sentences.zh: 例子有查尔斯顿、塞勒姆、布里斯托尔、普利茅斯、苏拉特、加勒、梅拉卡、索霍,以及东南亚、非洲和拉丁美洲先前的知名港口城市清单。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: E Much domestic port trade has not been recorded.
sentences.zh: 国内港口贸易大多没有记录。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: What evidence we have that domestic trade was greater at all periods than external trade.
sentences.zh: 我们掌握的哪些证据表明,国内贸易在所有时期比对外贸易更为重要。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Shanghai, for example, did most of its trade with other Chinese ports and inland cities.
sentences.zh: 例如,上海与其他中国港口和内陆城市的贸易大多是进行。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Calcutta traded mainly with other parts of India and so on.
sentences.zh: 加尔各答主要与印度其他地区进行交易,等等。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Most of any city’s population is engaged in providing goods and services for the city itself.
sentences.zh: 任何城市的人口大多为城市本身提供货物和服务。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Trade outside the city is its basic function.
sentences.zh: 城市外的贸易是其基本功能。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: But each basic worker requires food, housing, clothing and other such services.
sentences.zh: 但每个基本工人都需要食物、住房、衣服和其他此类服务。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Estimates of the ratio of basic to service workers range from 1A to 1:8.
sentences.zh: 基础工人与服务工人之比估计值从1A到1:8不等。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: F No city can be simply a port but must be involved in a variety of other activities.
sentences.zh: F 任何城市都不能只是一个港口,而必须参与各种其他活动。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The port function of the city draws to it raw materials and distributes them in many other forms.
sentences.zh: 该城市的港口功能吸引原材料,并以许多其他形式予以分配。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Ports take advantage of the need for breaking up the bulk material where water and land transport meet and where loading and unloading costs can be minimised by refining raw materials or turning them into finished goods.
sentences.zh: 港口利用需要拆散散散散散散散散的散装材料,供水和陆路运输使用,并可通过提炼原材料或将其转化为制成品,将装卸成本降到最低。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The major examples here are oil refining and ore refining, which are commonly located at ports.
sentences.zh: 这里的主要例子是炼油和矿石提炼,这些通常位于港口。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: It is not easy to draw a line around what is and is not a port function.
sentences.zh: 围绕港口功能而不是港口功能划一条界线并非易事。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: All ports handle, unload, sort, alter, process, repack, and reship most of what they receive.
sentences.zh: 所有港口都处理、卸货、排序、改变、加工、重新包装和重新装运它们收到的大部分货物。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: A city may still be regarded as a port city when it becomes involved in a great range of functions not immediately involved with ships or docks.
sentences.zh: 当一个城市参与一系列与船舶或码头没有直接相关的职能时,它仍可被视为港口城市。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: G Cities which began as ports retain the chief commercial and administrative centre of the city close to the waterfront.
sentences.zh: 以港口为起点的G城市保留了该城市靠近水边的主要商业和行政中心。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

words.def: 行政、行政、行政、行政、行政、行政、

sentences.en: The centre of New York is in lower Manhattan between two river mouths, the City of London is on the Thames, Shanghai along the Bund.
sentences.zh: 纽约中心位于曼哈顿下游, 位于两条河口之间, 伦敦市位于泰晤士河上, 上海沿邦德河。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This proximity to water is also true of Boston, Philadelphia, Bombay, Calcutta, Madras, Singapore, Bangkok, Hong Kong and Yokohama, where the commercial, financial, and administrative centres are still grouped around their harbours even though each city has expanded into a metropolis.
sentences.zh: 波士顿、费城、孟买、加尔各答、马德拉斯、新加坡、曼谷、香港和横滨等地,靠近水的地方也是如此,尽管每个城市都已经发展成大都市,但商业、金融和行政中心仍然集中在港口周围。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Even a casual visitor cannot mistake them as anything but port cities.
sentences.zh: 即使是临时游客也不能把他们误认为港口城市以外的任何城市。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

items.prompt: began as ports but other facilities later dominated
lost their prominence when large ships could not be accommodated
maintain their business centres near the port waterfront
Cities cease to be port cities when other functions dominate.
In the past, many port cities did more trade within their own country than with overseas ports.
Most people in a port city are engaged in international trade and finance.
Ports attract many subsidiary and independent industries.
Ports have to establish a common language of trade.
